unmapped.vs: Bracket colours sampled in vs-2-separations: parentheses 9400D3, braces 9ACD32
unmapped.reason: Left as is. In Rider the colours come from the third-party Rainbow Brackets plugin (keys ROUND_/SQUARE_/SQUIGGLY_/ANGLE_BRACKETS_RAINBOW_COLOR0..9, confirmed from the plugin's public source; its default B4960A was sampled in Rider). VS colours by overall nesting depth and the plugin per bracket type, so an exact match is impossible anyway, and the VS values are not theme defaults but come from an extension or setting outside the export
Visual Studio outlines the current line and does not fill it; Rider can only fill the caret row, so JetBrains' faint F8F8F8 fill is kept
Visual Studio paints the selection with an opacity that is not in the theme data; JetBrains' ADD6FF is kept until a selection is sampled
Absent from the Visual Studio theme files because Light is the built-in default. JetBrains' value A31515 is kept until sampled; keyword and comment are measured
